answers.english: Which reporting route do you mean: JoSAA/CSAB All India, Chhattisgarh quota, or NTPC quota? The document requirements differ.
answers.hindi: आप किस प्रवेश प्रक्रिया के दस्तावेज पूछ रहे हैं: जोसा/सीसैब ऑल इंडिया, छत्तीसगढ़ कोटा या एनटीपीसी कोटा? इनके नियम अलग हैं।
answers.hinglish: Aap kis reporting route ke documents pooch rahe hain: JoSAA/CSAB All India, Chhattisgarh quota, ya NTPC quota? Inke rules alag hain.

answers.english: For JoSAA/CSAB 2026 All India reporting, produce originals of Class 10 and 12 marksheets/pass certificates, transfer, migration and character certificates; applicable SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS and PwD certificates; the JEE (Main) 2026 rank card showing CRL; photo identity and permanent-address proof; medical fitness certificate; four colour passport photos; signed online anti-ragging undertaking; and balance-fee payment after JoSAA/CSAB adjustments. OBC-NCL/EWS status must be retained after 1 April 2026 in the JoSAA format; an undertaking is required after eligibility verification. Bank GST/transaction charges are separate. These are not the CG/NTPC checklist.
answers.hindi: जोसा/सीसैब 2026 ऑल इंडिया रिपोर्टिंग में मूल दस्तावेज लाएँ: कक्षा 10 और 12 की अंकसूची/पास प्रमाणपत्र, स्थानांतरण, माइग्रेशन और चरित्र प्रमाणपत्र; लागू होने पर एससी/एसटी/ओबीसी-एनसीएल/ईडब्ल्यूएस और दिव्यांगता प्रमाणपत्र; सीआरएल दिखाने वाला जेईई मेन 2026 रैंक कार्ड; फोटो पहचान और स्थायी पते का प्रमाण; चिकित्सा फिटनेस प्रमाणपत्र; चार रंगीन पासपोर्ट फोटो; ऑनलाइन बना हस्ताक्षरित एंटी रैगिंग शपथपत्र; और जोसा/सीसैब समायोजन के बाद शेष शुल्क। ओबीसी-एनसीएल/ईडब्ल्यूएस स्थिति 1 अप्रैल 2026 के बाद जोसा प्रारूप के अनुसार बनी हो और पात्रता जाँच के बाद अंडरटेकिंग देना होगा। बैंक के जीएसटी/लेनदेन शुल्क अलग हैं। यह सीजी/एनटीपीसी सूची नहीं है।
answers.hinglish: JoSAA/CSAB 2026 All India reporting ke liye originals laayen: Class 10 aur 12 marksheets/pass certificates, transfer, migration aur character certificates; applicable SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS aur PwD certificates; CRL wala JEE Main 2026 rank card; photo ID aur permanent-address proof; medical fitness certificate; chaar colour passport photos; signed online anti-ragging undertaking; aur JoSAA/CSAB adjustment ke baad balance fee. OBC-NCL/EWS status 1 April 2026 ke baad JoSAA format mein retained hona chahiye; eligibility verification ke baad undertaking chahiye. Bank GST/transaction charges alag hain. Yeh CG/NTPC checklist nahi hai.

answers.english: For the 2026 Chhattisgarh quota, both Classes 10 and 12 must be from schools in Chhattisgarh. Class 12 PCM aggregate must be at least 50% (45% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwD). Date of birth must be on/after 1 October 2000, relaxed to 1 October 1997 for those reserved categories. Eligible pass years are 2024, 2025 or 2026; a candidate who appeared and failed in 2023 but passed in 2024 is ineligible. Reserved-category certificates must be issued by the Chhattisgarh authority in the candidate’s own name at application; parents’ certificates are unacceptable. OBC-NCL certificates must be issued on/after 1 April 2026. Additional prescribed certificates apply for freedom-fighter/ex-servicemen wards and PwD applicants.
answers.hindi: 2026 छत्तीसगढ़ कोटा के लिए कक्षा 10 और 12 दोनों छत्तीसगढ़ के स्कूलों से हों। कक्षा 12 में भौतिकी, रसायन और गणित का कुल न्यूनतम 50% है (एससी/एसटी/ओबीसी-एनसीएल/दिव्यांग के लिए 45%)। जन्मतिथि 1 अक्टूबर 2000 या बाद की हो; इन आरक्षित वर्गों को 1 अक्टूबर 1997 तक छूट है। पास वर्ष 2024, 2025 या 2026 हो; 2023 में परीक्षा देकर असफल और 2024 में पास अभ्यर्थी पात्र नहीं है। आवेदन के समय आरक्षित वर्ग का प्रमाणपत्र छत्तीसगढ़ प्राधिकारी से अभ्यर्थी के अपने नाम पर हो; माता-पिता का प्रमाणपत्र स्वीकार नहीं है। ओबीसी-एनसीएल प्रमाणपत्र 1 अप्रैल 2026 या बाद का हो। स्वतंत्रता सेनानी/पूर्व सैनिक आश्रित और दिव्यांग अभ्यर्थियों के अतिरिक्त निर्धारित प्रमाणपत्र भी लागू हैं।
answers.hinglish: 2026 CG quota mein Class 10 aur 12 dono Chhattisgarh schools se hon. Class 12 PCM aggregate minimum 50% hai (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwD ke liye 45%). DOB 1 October 2000 ya baad ho; in reserved categories ko 1 October 1997 tak relaxation hai. Pass year 2024, 2025 ya 2026 ho; 2023 mein appear hokar fail aur 2024 mein pass candidate eligible nahi hai. Reserved certificate CG authority se candidate ke apne naam par application ke waqt ho; parents ka certificate acceptable nahi hai. OBC-NCL certificate 1 April 2026 ya baad issued ho. Freedom-fighter/ex-servicemen wards aur PwD applicants ke additional prescribed certificates bhi apply hote hain.

evidence.quote:
Chhattisgarh Quota: 50% of seats amount to 135 seats (45 in CSE, 45 in ECE
and 45 in DSAI) in this category. All the reservations under this quota will be as
per the norms of the Govt. of Chhattisgarh. These seats will be filled through
the IIIT-NR online counselling process (visit https://www.iiitnr.ac.in/
content/b-tech-admission-2026) The following are the eligibility criteria for
admission under this quota:
1. Candidates must pass the 10th and 12th standard examinations from the
schools in the State of Chhattisgarh only.
2.Candidates must have scored 50% aggregate marks in Chemistry, Physics and
Mathematics (45% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwD candidates) in their 12th
standard examination.
3.Candidates’ date of birth must be on or after October 01, 2000. For the
candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC-NCL and PwD, the upper age limit is
relaxable by three years, i.e. SC, ST, OBC-NCL, and PwD candidates’ date of
birth must be on or after October 01, 1997. Only the date of birth recorded by
the Secondary Education Board will be considered.
4.Candidates who passed their 12th standard examination or any other
qualifying examination in 2024, 2025 or 2026 shall be eligible. The
candidates who appeared in the 12th standard or equivalent qualifying
examinations in 2023, did not pass in 2023, but passed in 2024 are not
eligible.

5.Candidates seeking admission under reserved categories (SC/ ST/ OBC -
NCL) have to mandatorily submit their caste/category certificate issued by a
competent authority of Govt. of Chhattisgarh only in their name at the
time of application.
6.OBC-NCL candidates are required to produce an OBC-NCL certificate issued,
by the competent authorities, on or after 1st April 2026.

7. As per Govt. of Chhattisgarh norms, in addition to the vertical reservations
(SC/ST/OBC NCL), the following horzental reservations under the above
verticals:
Women – 30%
Children of Ex-Servicemen – 5%
Children or Grandchildren of Freedom Fighters – 3%
Persons with Disabilities – 5%
^ 2% of seats are reserved for the candidates of the Particularly Vulnerable Tribal
Group (PVTP) from the seats reserved for Scheduled Tribes (ST).
8.The wards/grandchildren of Freedom Fighters (FF) shall have to submit a
certificate (Annexure III) issued by the competent authorities that his/her
parent/grandparent is a freedom fighter.
9.The wards of Ex‐servicemen shall have to submit a certificate (Annexure IV)
issued by the Army Commanding Officer or Zila Sainik Welfare Officers.
10.For Persons with Disabilities (PwD), the following certificates are required
to be submitted:
i. Certificate issued by District Medical Board certifying disability
ii. Certificate from Superintendent, Government of India, and Ministry of
Labour certifying that candidate is eligible to study for the subject applied.
11. A caste/category certificate issued in the name of either of the parents
(Mother/ Father) is unacceptable.
Forwards of Kashmiri Migrants, a certificate from the competent authority (Sub‐
Divisional Officer ‐ Revenue) is required.

2. Education loan under PM-Vidyalaxmi
2.1. Under PM-Vidyalaxmi, a special loan product of collateral-free and guarantor-free education
loans is introduced. This education loan will be available to students who get admission on their
own merit to quality Higher Education Institutions (QHEIs) in India. The criteria of selecting
QHEIs are given at paragraph 6 of this guideline.
2.2. Students of all family income groups will be eligible to get this education loan, if they so desire.
2.3. There is no cut-off on highest amount of education loan. It will depend on course fee and other
fees charged by the QHEI and other associated expenses (like mess, hostel fee, other refundable and
non-refundable fees of the QHEI, cost of a reasonable quality laptop and reasonable amount of living
expenses required by the student during the course period). This amount will vary from QHEI to
QHEI. An example of the same may be seen at Annexure I.
2.4. All students getting admission in the QHEIs in India for degree/ diploma programmes can avail
this benefit. There will be no limit on number of students getting such loans.
2.5. Loan will be made accessible through a simple, transparent, student-friendly and
entirely digital application process, with a simple 2-page application format. The name of the
portal will be same as name of the scheme.

2.6. Students admitted through open competitive examinations/ merit based admission shall get this
loan. Students admitted through management quota (or similar quota) will not be eligible.
2.7. Bank may take life insurance cover of the student borrower if the loan amount is above certain
threshold, to be decided by individual banks. As per request of the borrower, the insurance premium
can be included in the education loan amount.
2.8. The repayment period of the education loan would be up to 15 years excluding moratorium
period (Course period + 1 year), which is same as IBA Model Education Loan Scheme guidelines.

3.1. A student whose annual family income is up to ₹ 8 lakhs and who is pursuing any course from

9.1. Under the Scheme, moratorium period is defined as Course Period plus one year.
9.2. Interest computation will be at simple annual rate on the outstanding principal disbursed

the condition that the student completes the course of study successfully.

moratorium period.

payment of principal shall be paid by the borrower.

by the student according to the loan agreement with the bank which gave the education
loan.
